QuestInfo.name: [11주년] 테마던전 버섯의 성 클리어!
QuestInfo.0: 축제지기 버섯이 새롭게 오픈한 버섯의 성과 관련하여 할 이야기가 있다고 한다. 무슨 이야기인 지 들어보도록 하자.
QuestInfo.1:
The story of the noble mushrooms is being told again. Manager Mush is marking the occasion with 10th Anniversary Coins for anyone who clears the Mushroom Castle. Hurry and show Manager Mush the 'Violetta's Knight' title to get yours before time runs out!

#rCaution! This quest can be only completed once per account, and you cannot receive the rewards after 23:59 on June 25th.#k
QuestInfo.2: You showed the Manager Mush your 'Violetta's Knight' title and got the 10th Anniversary Coin.

default.0: Still no Violetta's Knight title? You can get it by doing Mushroom Castle quests. Remember, #rno coins will be given after QRQRQR on TKTKTK even with the title#k. So hurry!
